WITH player_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    AVG(CAST(points_won AS FLOAT) / CAST(points_max AS FLOAT)) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM player_award_vote
  WHERE points_won IS NOT NULL AND points_max IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY player_id
),
overall_avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) as overall_avg
  FROM player_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(ps.avg_ratio) as avg_voting_ratio,
  AVG(ps.record_count) as avg_record_count,
  AVG(ps.record_count - oac.overall_avg) as avg_count_diff
FROM player_stats ps, overall_avg_count oac
WHERE ps.record_count > oac.overall_avg
